name: Vegas Frucindra ASA Gridfinity
filament_start_gcode:
; GRIDFINITY variant (2026-11-17): 250C, bed 115C, part fan OFF on walls, 25% on bridges/steep overhangs, exhaust OFF while printing (PRINT_END vents 10 min); the 3x5 pliers bin printed almost flat this way (only slight outer-corner lift). History: - tall bins warped at the corners and split layers at the edges with 240C / fan 30% / exhaust 25% (chamber averaged 43.5C, dipped to 38C). Base profile: Frucindra ASA black on Vegas (2 kg, lot 0706PR6D07; calibration suite v5, 2026-11-14): 240C, max 16 mm3/s (extruder clicked at 22), flow 102%, PA 0.04, retract 0.2 @ 40, tolerance 0.1 mm; bed 110C (plates warped across the front of the bed at 100C, 2026-11-14); fan 30%, 100% on overhangs/bridges. Temperature tower lifted off its raft at 245C (bed 100C). Klipper owns PA and retraction
SET_PRESSURE_ADVANCE ADVANCE=0.06   ; recalibrated at 260C, bed 115, fan off (2026-11-19): PA 0.06, flow 100%, retract 0.2@40, tolerance 0.2
SET_RETRACTION RETRACT_LENGTH=0.2 RETRACT_SPEED=40 UNRETRACT_SPEED=30
